summary: AXT, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the adjournment of its 2026 Annual Meeting due to lack of quorum. The meeting will reconvene on June 4, 2026 at the company's headquarters. No changes to proposals or record date (March 20, 2026) were made. This is a routine procedural filing about a delayed shareholder meeting, not a special situation. No strategic event, acquisition, divestiture, or management change is involved.
